topRisks: Default stdio of Claude Code, Codex, and grok sends initialize. G4-only on every in-repo stdio host (nlp-mcp .mcp.json included) fails those sessions. grok has no stdio modern opt-in at all.

Official conformance --requirements 2026-07-28 is a modern-only referee: initialize MUST be HTTP 404/-32601. Effect G4 HTTP today is 400/-32020 (stdio -32022 without data.supported). Dual-era mixed list fails the same check because initialize succeeds. Stdio hosts cannot be scored without an HTTP shim.

A browser Inspector or TS v2 2026 client fails CORS preflight against a host whose allow-list omits mcp-method/mcp-name (ontology /mcp as of 21-r2), even if the handshake is right. Inspector web still skips Mcp-Param-* mirroring.

HTTP 400 is era-ambiguous unless the body is a recognized modern error. Clients that treat any 400 as legacy will send initialize and fail again against a G4 HTTP host; spec-compliant clients that recognize -32020 stay modern.
